entries.label: Persistence: user LaunchAgents - runs from temp/shared/hidden path
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1543.001. Flags plists whose launched executable lives in /tmp, /var/folders or the shared users folder, has a hidden basename, or is a shell/interpreter whose script or command references those temp paths. Log paths (StandardOutPath etc.) are deliberately not matched. XML plists only: binary plists are skipped by the content scanner.

entries.label: Persistence: user LaunchAgents - shell/interpreter one-liner or dylib injection
entries.notes: High. MITRE T1543.001, T1574.006. DYLD_*/LD_PRELOAD environment keys, sh -c wrappers around curl/nc/python/osascript, curl|sh, /dev/tcp, base64 -d, or osascript as the launched program. XML plists only.

entries.label: Persistence: user LaunchAgent masquerading as Apple
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1036.005 / T1543.001. Apple's own launch items live on the sealed system volume, not in the user's LaunchAgents folder. Alerts on any file there with a com.apple. prefix. Known benign leftover: com.apple.CSConfigDotMacCert-*.plist from the MobileMe era. Review the program path.

entries.label: Persistence: ~/.zshrc and ~/.zshenv (and backups) - malicious idioms
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1546.004. Content match for download-and-execute, reverse-shell, dylib-injection and sudo/su shadowing idioms. The alias/function check can fire on legitimate `alias sudo='sudo '`. Globs deliberately exclude *_history and *_sessions.

entries.label: Persistence: /etc/zshenv exists
entries.notes: High. Sourced by every zsh invocation, interactive or not. Not present on a stock macOS install (verify on your OS version).

entries.label: Persistence: /etc/zlogin or /etc/zlogout exists
entries.notes: High. Not present on a stock macOS install (verify on your OS version).

entries.label: Persistence: periodic daily scripts - malicious idioms
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1053.003-adjacent (periodic runs via launchd). Runs as root. Content match only: new, benign scripts are not flagged (the checker has no new-file condition).

entries.label: Persistence: periodic weekly scripts - malicious idioms
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1053.003-adjacent (periodic runs via launchd). Runs as root. Content match only: new, benign scripts are not flagged (the checker has no new-file condition).

entries.label: Persistence: periodic *.local override exists
entries.notes: Medium. /etc/daily.local, weekly.local and monthly.local run as root from the periodic job. Not present by default.

entries.label: Persistence: emond rule runs a command
entries.notes: High. MITRE T1546.014. Event Monitor was removed in macOS Ventura. Matches RunCommand actions, the persistence mechanism; the stock SampleRules.plist that can survive upgrades does not use one.

entries.label: Persistence: user Folder Action script exists
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1546 (event-triggered execution; Folder Actions have no dedicated sub-technique). Folder Action Scripts in the user Library are not present by default.

entries.label: Access: SSH authorized_keys exists
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1098.004. Alerts when any authorized_keys file exists. Expected to fire on Macs that legitimately accept SSH logins; drop this entry for those hosts.

entries.label: Persistence: ~/.ssh/rc exists
entries.notes: High. Executed on every SSH login. Not present by default.

entries.label: Persistence: /etc/ssh/sshrc exists
entries.notes: High. Executed on every SSH login for all users. Not present by default.

entries.label: Access: ~/.ssh/config runs local commands
entries.notes: Medium. PermitLocalCommand yes / LocalCommand runs a command on each connection. ProxyCommand is intentionally not matched (common in bastion setups).

entries.label: Access: sshd_config weakened or changed
entries.notes: Medium. Hash change plus content match for root login, empty passwords, AuthorizedKeysCommand, GatewayPorts, PermitTunnel. Expect a change alert after macOS updates that rewrite it.

entries.label: Access: sshd_config.d drop-in weakened or changed
entries.notes: Medium. Same checks as sshd_config, applied to drop-in files.

entries.label: Auth: PAM config changed or loads external module
entries.notes: High. MITRE T1556.003. Hash change plus pam_exec/pam_script or a module loaded by absolute path (pam_reattach is exempted). Expect one change alert after macOS updates that touch PAM files.

entries.label: Auth: sudo_local has modules beyond Touch ID
entries.notes: High. MITRE T1556.003. sudo_local is the supported place to enable Touch ID (pam_tid) and smartcards. Any other auth/account/password/session module is flagged (pam_reattach exempted), including third-party pam_watchid.

entries.label: Defense evasion: library validation preference exists
entries.notes: High. MITRE T1562.001. Created when DisableLibraryValidation is set, which lets unsigned or foreign-signed dylibs load into hardened apps.

entries.label: Traffic: /etc/hosts changed or blocks Apple security hosts
entries.notes: Medium. Hash change plus entries for Apple OCSP, update and device-management hosts. Some privacy-minded users block ocsp.apple.com deliberately.

entries.label: Browser: Chrome native messaging host (user) runs from temp/hidden path
entries.notes: Medium. MITRE T1176.001. Native messaging hosts let a browser extension execute a local binary. Flags a host whose binary lives in temp, shared or hidden paths.
